TP (Paris:TEP), a global leader in digital business services, today announced the appointment of Benoit Gabelle as Group Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately.
Benoit Gabelle has served as Interim Group Chief Financial Officer since March 2026 when Jorge Amar was appointed Chief Executive Officer of TP.

Benoit Gabelle joined TP as Group Deputy Chief Financial Officer in 2022, responsible for Financial Reporting & Consolidation, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and Finance Transformation. Over the past four years, he has supported the Group’s management on key financial matters, including the deployment of unified financial systems, the structuring and integration of Majorel and more recently the refinancing of the Group and its efficiency program.

Prior to joining TP, Benoit Gabelle spent 17 years working in France and in Hong Kong, first with KPMG and then with EY, where he was a Partner specializing in international taxation and transfer pricing matters.
In his role, Benoit Gabelle will focus on four key priorities:
- Ensuring the Group's transformation delivers shareholder value,
- Providing strategic and financial support to Operations across the Group,
- Modernizing the finance function through simpler processes and technology,
- Strengthening investor relations and optimizing Group financing, balance-sheet and liquidity.

Jorge Amar, CEO of TP, commented: “Benoit’s confirmation as Group CFO is a well-deserved recognition of the strong leadership he has demonstrated at TP. Since stepping into the role on an interim basis, he has shown the strategic clarity and steady leadership our finance function needs as we advance TP's transformation and integrate AI within our processes. I look forward to further partnering with him to accelerate our transformation.”
